column7: core UpdateSecretWithPermissionCheck/DeleteSecretWithPermissionCheck let a secret owner (viewer@A, no secrets.write/secrets.delete) update and delete the secret through the owner pass of checkSecretPermission, while the REST/gRPC per-secret gates (AuthorizeSecretPrincipalForSecretAction: ACL, role, share; no owner pass) refused (authzdiff waiver known-03). Fixed by requireOwnerHoldsGatePermission: an owner-sourced grant must also pass AuthorizeSecretAction for the gate permission.
